title: NOMOS Chain Key Revocation List
description: Response body from GET /.well-known/nomos-chain-revocations (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §5.3) — a signed, dated aggregation of currently-revoked chain keys. Mirrors NOMOS-SPEC-006's revocation-list.schema.json in structure and purpose, one level down (keys, not artifact versions).

generated_at.description: When this list was assembled. Part of the signed payload.

kid.description: Key id used to sign the list as a whole — the deployment's own platform key, not a claim of revocation authority over any key in the list. Each contained statement carries its own issuer's independent signature.

statements.description: Every currently-active chain-key revocation statement known to the deployment, verbatim, in any order. MAY be empty.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over JCS({ generated_at, statements }).
